description: This file contains functional tests for the `af vc verify` CLI command, including testing workflow VC chain creation, JSON verification, and tampering detection. It uses asynchronous testing with pytest and asyncio, and interacts with external modules for HTTP clients, agent server setup, and the verification process.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _wait_for_vc_chain( client, workflow_id: str, *, minimum_components: int = 1, timeout: float = 30.0, )
methods.description: Polls the workflow VC chain endpoint until the specified minimum number of components are present or a timeout occurs.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _run_vc_verify(vc_file: Path, *, expect_success: bool = True)
methods.description: Executes the `af vc verify` command on a given VC JSON file and parses the output, asserting success or failure based on expectations.

methods.name: test_vc_cli_verifies_workflow_chain(make_test_agent, async_http_client, tmp_path)
methods.description: Main async test function that sets up an agent, creates a VC chain, verifies it offline via CLI, and tests tampering detection.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] attest_event(event_type: str, payload: Dict[str, Any])

ctags.name: _run_vc_verify
ctags.pattern: /^async def _run_vc_verify(vc_file: Path, *, expect_success: bool = True) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: _wait_for_vc_chain
ctags.signature: ( client, workflow_id: str, *, minimum_components: int = 1, timeout: float = 30.0, )

ctags.name: attest_event
ctags.pattern: /^    async def attest_event(event_type: str, payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/
